lines.beaver_en: Cleaning is tough, right? What are you doing there?
lines.learner: 바닥에 얼룩이 있어. 아무리 닦아도 안 지워져.
lines.en: There's a stain on the floor. It won't come off no matter how much I wipe.
lines.roman: badage eollugi isseo. amuri dakkado an jiwojyeo.

lines.beaver: 세제를 바꿔 볼까? 다른 거 있어.
lines.beaver_en: Should we try a different detergent? I have another one.
lines.beaver_roman: sejereul bakkwo bolkka? dareun geo isseo.
lines.learner: 응, 이 세제는 아무리 많이 써도 소용없어.
lines.en: Yeah, this detergent is useless no matter how much I use.
lines.roman: eung, i sejeneun amuri mani sseodo soyongeopseo.

lines.beaver: 이거 써 봐. 그런데 무슨 얼룩이야?
lines.beaver_en: Try this. But what kind of stain is it?
lines.beaver_roman: igeo sseo bwa. geureonde museun eollugiya?
lines.learner: 풀 같아. 지난번에 장식 만들다가 흘렸어.
lines.en: I think it's glue. I spilled it making decorations last time.
lines.roman: pul gata. jinanbeone jangsik mandeuldaga heullyeosseo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 칼 같은 걸로 긁어 보는 게 어때?
lines.beaver_en: Then how about scraping it with something like a knife?
lines.beaver_roman: geureom kal gateun geollo geulgeo boneun ge eottae?
lines.en: A knife is dangerous, so I'll scrape it with a stick.

lines.beaver: 오, 조금 지워진다! 참, 그릇은 정리했어?
lines.beaver_en: Oh, it's coming off a bit! By the way, did you put the dishes away?
lines.beaver_roman: o, jogeum jiwojinda! cham, geureuseun jeongnihaesseo?
lines.learner: 응, 그릇은 찬장 위 칸에 넣어 뒀어.
lines.en: Yes, I put the dishes on the top shelf of the cupboard.
lines.roman: eung, geureuseun chanjang wi kane neoeo dwosseo.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. Who's going to sweep the living room floor?
lines.en: I'll sweep and then run the vacuum cleaner.

lines.beaver_en: Good. There's a lot of dust under the sofa too.
lines.learner: 어? 소파 밑에서 열쇠고리랑 바늘이 나왔어.
lines.en: Huh? A key ring and a needle came out from under the sofa.
lines.roman: eo? sopa miteseo yeolsoegorirang baneuri nawasseo.

lines.beaver_en: The needle is dangerous, so let's put it away quickly.
lines.learner: 응, 바로 치울게. 생활용품 상자에 넣을게.
lines.en: Okay, I'll clear it right away. I'll put it in the household goods box.
lines.roman: eung, baro chiulge. saenghwallyongpum sangjae neoeulge.

lines.beaver_en: Shouldn't we wipe behind the home appliances too?
lines.learner: 응, 히터 뒤는 아무리 닦아도 먼지가 나와.
lines.en: Yeah, no matter how much I wipe behind the heater, dust keeps coming out.
lines.roman: eung, hiteo dwineun amuri dakkado meonjiga nawa.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, the stain is all gone too! It's so clean.
lines.en: Finally! It was tiring, but it feels good to do a big cleaning.
